title: Fix $ref/$id mismatch so schemas validate with ajv, not just VS Code
summary: All data/schema/*.json files use file-relative $ref paths (e.g. "common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/X") which VS Code resolves fine for editor validation, but a real validator like ajv can't — it resolves $ref against each schema's declared $id, and sf2e-common.schema.json's self-declared $id ("sf2e-common.schema.json") doesn't match the path other schemas reference it by ("common/sf2e-common.schema.json").
description:
Discovered while trying to actually run creature.schema.json against ajv-cli to validate a test fixture (foundry/blank-inheritance/data/_test-fixtures/test-creature.json) for the Foundry module test case. ajv-cli failed with "can't resolve reference common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/$defs/combatStatblock from id creature.schema.json" — confirmed this is an $id/path mismatch, not an actual data problem (the fixture was hand-verified against the schema definitions directly and looks correct).

This affects every schema in data/schema/ that references common/sf2e-common.schema.json (kid, frame, npc, creature, subsystem, challenge), not just creature.schema.json. Worth fixing before building any real automated validator (ROADMAP.md #1's future sync tool will need real schema validation, not just VS Code's editor-time checking) — likely fix is giving sf2e-common.schema.json an $id that matches how it's actually referenced (e.g. a full relative path or a proper URI), or switching all $refs to a consistent absolute-ish scheme ajv can resolve without extra configuration.
sourceContext: Discovered while validating test fixtures for the Foundry module test-case implementation. Fixed while bootstrapping the automated test suite (design/testing-strategy.md) the same day — this became a hard prerequisite for tier 2 (data corpus validation), which needs real ajv resolution to exist at all.
resolution: Fixed by changing sf2e-common.schema.json's own $id from "sf2e-common.schema.json" to "common/sf2e-common.schema.json", matching the path every referencing schema already used in its $ref (kid, frame, npc, creature, subsystem, challenge all referenced it as "common/sf2e-common.schema.json#/..." — none needed to change). Confirmed frame.schema.json's local #/$defs/bandRef and sf2e-common's own internal #/$defs/* refs were unaffected, as expected (fragment-only refs resolve against the current document regardless of $id). Verified with ajv (Ajv2020, draft 2020-12): all 15 real files under data/ now validate against their declared $schema — covered by test/tier2-data-corpus.test.mjs.
